input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Bluefly anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements", "procure" and competitor-related language return only unrelated uses (warranty exclusivity in § 5.2, nonexclusive licenses in §§ 5.4/12.1, tax-exclusive charges in § 4.3, and discretion references). Affirmatively, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) confirms that each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others, so we retain full freedom to buy comparable services from other suppliers. The only restriction on Customer in this area is § 14.11 (No Resale), which prohibits reselling the Services rather than restricting our sourcing, and so is not an exclusivity covenant. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer); no redline required.
